source_evidence: Exact player 'Done. We will need to restore this place and make it profitable. I trust you will put up your best effort. Tell me what we need and you shall have it.' confirms Hessa Marr's appointment as steward of the intended Vaishnavi service-house recovery/property, subject to the already-held conditional Crown grant, without transferring her family's existing dwelling, independent ferry, landing/access/return-channel rights or revenue to V. Hessa voluntarily accepts. Apply existing campaign DAILY WAGE SCALE senior manager Wealthy5gp per actual workday, comparable to Tamsin and Meret; DM-selected standard rate consistent with player acceptance of fair terms, not a bespoke wage ruling. Hessa agrees to begin paid duties Day332 morning, common payroll cycle 201+7n, first payday Day334 for actual completed workdays, no wages earned/paid tonight. V instructs restoration and sustainable profit, active effort, report actual needs. Hessa's mandate includes proactive daily customer outreach and follow-through, realistic local market and cost assessment, obtaining qualified condition/safety and parcel verification, safe isolation/repair quotes for damaged ledge and masonry, drainage upkeep with warders, prioritizing habitation/safety, assessing shelter/meal/feed/stabling/storage opportunities and traffic/demand before committing capital. Coordinate guardian duties with Marr family and Crown law, no exploitation, detention, tribute, toll monopoly, automatically lawful undead deployment or coercion. Ordinary professional planning/outreach under standing D199/D225/D244 estate autonomy may proceed on actual eligible workdays, but no fabricated inspection or demand, no arbitrary delay, no sale or customer orders until actual lawful available services and independent assent. V promises to consider/provide needs, no specified personal capital amount, estate cash transfer, loan, hiring beyond Hessa, repair budget, purchase or expense authorized/booked. Apply ordinary standing funding and actual affordability controls, not discretionary reserves; no separate estate cash balance invented. Hessa will bring concrete itemized funding/working-capital request after obtaining information. Provisional stewardship accepted now; formal ownership, parcel extent, structural survey, Crown verification and operating status unresolved. No wage expense or personal cash movement at appointment. No roll for mutually agreed appointment. Day331~19:00. V next choice; all resources/custody unchanged.
